summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — CTEC.L +9%, ASM.AS +3%, WTB.L +3%, GAW.L +3%, BESI.AS +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ANTO.L -8%, EDV.L -8%, AAL.L -7%, GLEN.L -7%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: CTEC.L (+9.42%) — No obvious news catalyst found for 2026-11-19. Searches for Convatec (CTEC.L) turned up nothing dated today, so this is likely a technical or sector rebound in UK medtech or large-cap healthcare. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: Convatec is a FTSE 100 mid/large-cap medtech name that none of the strategies list. With no identifiable news driver, a news-reactive bot would also have had no trigger, and a +9.4% gap was probably too large to chase.
